# Objective

Audit whether context values and future covariates were actually available at a simulated historical forecast origin.

# Run

```bash
python python/qm025_tsfm_information_audit.py
```

# Experiment

Move the availability date of `future_realized_macro` to the forecast origin and rerun. Then explain whether that change is a legitimate information assumption or merely a way to make the audit pass.

The lab does not download or benchmark any pretrained model. It isolates the reusable information-timing contract.
